# Run-All Query Suite

In run-all mode, generate a custom `.qls` query suite file at runtime. This ensures all queries from all installed packs actually execute, avoiding the silent filtering caused by each pack's `defaultSuiteFile`.

## Why a Custom Suite

When you pass a pack name directly to `codeql database analyze` (e.g., `-- codeql/cpp-queries`), CodeQL uses the pack's `defaultSuiteFile` field from `qlpack.yml`. For official packs, this is typically `codeql-suites/<lang>-code-scanning.qls`
